name: Daisy Daydream Gemstone Convertible Wrap
materials: turquoise heishi, carnelian, apatite, aquamarine, moonstone, Java gooseberry beads, mother-of-pearl flowers; gold-filled 14/20 beads and extender chain, end components; PVD heart clasp
description:
A playful mix of turquoise heishi, carnelian, apatite, aquamarine, moonstone, and Java gooseberry beads gives this necklace its bright, playful feel. Mother-of-pearl flowers add a soft shimmer, while gold-filled beads and an extender chain bring a warm finish. It closes with a PVD heart clasp.

Designed to be worn as a bracelet wrap or necklace.
